town_description: Shillong, the capital of Meghalaya at about 1,525 m in the East Khasi Hills, is the former capital of undivided Assam, known as the 'Scotland of the East'. Its attractions include Shillong Peak, Elephant Falls, Wards Lake, the Don Bosco Museum and a vibrant music culture. The city has several Hindu temples (Kali, Shiva, Hanuman) alongside churches and the indigenous Khasi Niam Khasi sacred sites.
